incident_description: Average first-response time to support tickets increased from 2 hours to 11 hours, breaching SLA for 34% of enterprise accounts.

corrective_actions: Auto-notify support/comms when engineering flags critical bugs.

incident_description: Checkout abandonment rate increased from 35% to 58% over 8 weeks, resulting in approximately $120K lost monthly revenue.

why_chain.question: Why are customers abandoning checkout?
why_chain.answer: Session recordings show 73% of drop-offs occur at the shipping cost reveal on step 3 of 5.

why_chain.question: Why does the shipping cost cause drop-offs?
why_chain.answer: A new carrier contract increased standard shipping from $4.99 to $11.99; customers see the price only at checkout.

why_chain.question: Why do customers only see the cost at checkout?
why_chain.answer: Shipping is calculated after entering a delivery address on step 3, with no upfront estimate on product or cart pages.

why_chain.question: Why was no upfront estimate built into the original flow?
why_chain.answer: Checkout was designed when shipping was flat-rate $4.99, so early cost communication was not perceived as necessary.

why_chain.question: Why wasn't checkout redesigned when the carrier contract changed?
why_chain.answer: The product team treated the carrier switch as a backend-only change; no UX review is triggered by pricing changes affecting customer experience.

root_cause: No cross-functional UX review process when backend pricing changes affect the customer checkout experience.
corrective_actions: Add shipping cost estimator on product and cart pages via IP geolocation.
Mandate UX review for any pricing change affecting checkout.

root_cause: Product OKRs exclude engineering health metrics (deploy frequency, change failure rate, tech debt ratio), leaving no organizational support for legacy modernization.
corrective_actions: Add engineering health metrics to team OKRs.

incident_description: In an underground coal section, a roof bolt plate detached during bolting operations; the operator escaped injury but production was halted for 6 hours.

why_chain.question: Why was ground scanning skipped?
why_chain.answer: The shift target prioritized meters bolted over the mandatory scan-every-3-meters rule.

why_chain.question: Why did production targets override the scanning rule?
why_chain.answer: Weekly KPIs reward advance rate without a balanced metric for ground support compliance.

why_chain.question: Why are KPIs imbalanced?
why_chain.answer: The mine's performance management system was not updated after the last roof-fall near-miss to include support-compliance weighting.

root_cause: Performance management KPIs reward advance rate without weighting ground-support compliance, encouraging skipping of mandatory pre-bolt scanning.
corrective_actions: Rebalance KPIs to include ground-scan compliance.
Enforce scan-every-3-meters with automatic work-stop interlock.

incident_description: A SaaS company's payment processing service returned 500 errors for 47 minutes during peak hours, blocking all checkout transactions.

why_chain.question: Why did the payment API return 500 errors?
why_chain.answer: The database connection pool was exhausted; all 50 connections were held by long-running queries.

why_chain.question: Why were queries running so long?
why_chain.answer: A new report query scanned 12 million rows without an index on the created_at column.

why_chain.question: Why was there no index on created_at?
why_chain.answer: The migration adding the report feature did not include index creation and passed code review without a database review.

why_chain.question: Why was there no database review?
why_chain.answer: The team has no mandatory database review step for migrations touching tables with more than 1 million rows.

why_chain.question: Why is there no such process?
why_chain.answer: Database performance guidelines exist in a wiki but are not enforced in the CI/CD pipeline or PR checklist.

root_cause: Database performance guidelines are documented but not enforced in CI/CD or PR workflows for high-volume table migrations.
corrective_actions: Add CI check flagging migrations on large tables without index changes.
Require 'database review' label on migration PRs affecting tables >1M rows.
